posts.title: Load only when the next results become relevant
posts.excerpt: A nearby sentinel delays optional work while still giving the interface enough time to append the next page smoothly.

posts.title: Let appended content move the boundary naturally
posts.excerpt: New cards push the sentinel forward, allowing a second entry to trigger the next request without a separate scroll listener.

posts.title: Release observation when the final page arrives
posts.excerpt: A null next-page reference makes the terminal condition explicit and lets the component destroy a tracker it no longer needs.
